one.text: The Seedcore is where the survivors of the assault emerge on New Phyrexia and first see Realmbreaker, the corrupted World Tree, as a flash from its upper branches signals that the invasion has begun.
In the tree's root chamber they find Karn vivisected and bound, and he tells them they must detonate the sylex at the root source, so Jace volunteers to take it.
On the bridge Elspeth and Tyvar fight the compleated Ajani and Tibalt, with Elspeth refusing Ajani's call to join Phyrexia, until Tyvar kills Tibalt and Elspeth blasts Ajani unconscious.

Hidden by illusion, Jace pours his grief into the sylex and speaks the words to activate it, but Elspeth drops through the ceiling, runs him through and vanishes with the sylex, and then Realmbreaker pulses and carries Phyrexian invaders through the Omenpaths to other planes.
